reason: The reviewer identifies the exact same defect: onError returns the raw `maybeError` parameter instead of the resolved `error` variable, so in the single-arg call shape (maybeError undefined) the function returns undefined even though it logged the real error, causing the SDK's `throw this.onError(e)` to rethrow undefined. This matches the ground truth's mechanism precisely, just with more supporting detail (line numbers, docblock quote).
